shared_invariants: preserve exact face, short dark navy hair, mint hair clip, bright blue eyes, indigo oversized hoodie, dark shorts, ankle boots, 2.7-head proportions, palette and rendering style; one centered full-body character; transparent background; no text, logo, watermark, shadow, cropping or extra limbs

prompts.hover_anchor: Render the same character looking slightly upward with a happy expression and raising one hand in a small cheerful wave; no prop.
prompts.loading_anchor: Render the same character calmly waiting with both hands cupped around one small mint-blue floating light orb; no terminal, keyboard or work tools.
prompts.working_anchor: Render the same character leaning slightly forward with a focused expression and both hands actively operating one mint-blue floating holographic terminal; no extra work props.

animation_expansion.method: deterministic local transform from one approved state anchor
